title: Record the source value of the second quarter
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 19679, register 280 holds `-1/8` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `2` and contributes `-1/4` to register 354, which holds `-1/4` until then.
- Register 280 is `-1/4` after event 19133. Event 19671 adds `-1/2` times register 354 and leaves `-1/8`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
